notes.title: Season 4 BETA is now online!
notes.content:
Hello,

We wanted to bring you the S4 Beta due to major changes in the end game (wormholes).

Due to popular demand, and taking in new player motivation to compete on the leaderboards we have done these things:

- iLevel capped
- Wormhole system re-vamped
- Toxic WH effects removed
- Wormhole levels are now randomized

We don't want the wormhole level gain to get out of hand, so rather make it about skills + talent/stat optimization in order to progress higher.

Also since the wormhole levels are now randomized, botting and clear tactics no longer work.

There will be more areas in the launch, but just 2 for now in wormholes.

Join the beta by choosing the beta tab in properties, and check the code "HEROSIEGEBETA666" in order to opt in the beta.

notes.title: Upcoming patch and negative reviews
notes.content:
Helloooo!!

Sooo we have been going over the negative reviews and you do all have good points about various things in the game.

We have come into conclusions about what we will improve and do so here you go, a list of stuff thats coming in the next patch:

New mana system
Mana will now work very differently. Every spell has a starting percentage like 10% etc, which is the base manacost from your maximum mana. On top of this, spells cost will scale very slightly per talent point by a small flat number. This means that there will never be a situation where you cant cast a spell due to lack of mana.

Balance
We are addressing the oneshot stuff by decreasing damage from bosses and minibosses, as well as re-work/improve bosses like Death. We aim to bring a bit longer boss fights, but so that the boss doesn't instantly punish you. Also enemies are now a tad more interesting since rare enemies have way more hp than before, but the normal ones are the usual hack n slash.

Potion Pickup
Picking up potions now makes you immortal for the pickup duration and slightly after, so no more getting killed by potions. Tho you should still be cautious not to get surrounded ^^

Translations
We will be bringing translations for China, Japan and Korea.

Paladin + White Mage shields
We re-worked the shields completely, you can now tank a ton of damage, and the bubble has its own healthbar in order to track its HP better.

Twinking
You can now talk to Gar Nor and lock your EXP gain so you can twink a low level character.

Servers
You no longer need to put password on a private server. Joining to servers wont crash anymore, that got worked out.

Dropping Items (Trading)
You can now drop items to the ground and they appear to every player in the game, and they can also pick them up. So now you can give that epic loot to your friends. 

Overall
Improvements in performance, networking and overall bug fixes.


So yeah, keep those reviews coming, positive or negative. As longs it has feedback and helps us with our work ^^

notes.title: Season 3 + Hero Siege 2.0!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5560948/9a24e9b87abe0bdede112b2d98bdcddd1962e62b.png

Season 2 is now over, and its time to move on to Season 3. The rewards are available in the shop section for Season 2.

We have been working hard to bring you this patch, hopefully you all enjoy the content and stuff we have done! All feedback is very welcome!

Here are the patch notes for 2.0.0.0

MAJOR
- Wave system is now removed from the main game, we have made a new randomly generating world for the game that focuses
more on exploring and smashing packs of enemies to pieces.
- Runes added to the game. You can now obtain various runes that come out as 1-5 star runes. These runes can be equipped and
upgraded with rubies, the more stars the more stats per level. 5 Runes can be equipped at once. (found in the talent screen tab)
- Most enemy sprites are re-made, and now have attack animations.
- All minibosses in the game have been re-worked to match a more interesting boss fight.
- Exp gains, item level scaling etc has been optimized.
- There is now an online matchmaking system that matches players together according to your settings.
- Private servers will be working as before in another tab.
- Massive improvements in multiplayer engine and overall performance.
- Solo leaderboards are now class based.
- Hero Level leaderboards added in.
- Added translation for Finnish, Brazil and Russian

GENERAL
- You can no longer use spells while frozen or stunned
- Player base movement speed has been increased
- Enemies with enhance abilities are now determined by an "aura" beneath them
- Wormhole puddles that appear after enemies die now increase in size over time from 0 and disappear faster
- Fixed ESC boss dungeon spawn bug in wormholes
- Minimap is now much lighter regarding performance, and improved visually
- You can now check your DPS on the dummies by talking to Gar Nor in town
- Off stats on items lowered to 75% from what it was
- Hero Levels now give +0.5% more item level on items per level.

FIXES
- Fixed a crash in Wormhole Abomination boss.
- Fixed a bug with client armor.
- Fixed high item levels displaying incorrectly.
- Fixed item level on dropped items.
- The game can now be paused when playing online multiplayer alone.
- Dodge is now tied to chest piece, no longer scales with armor. (now also works vs spells etc)
- Manacosts are now compressed to K, M, B etc
- Fixed talents sometimes not activating in online multiplayer
- Leviathan's puddles now dissapear upon death
- Eye boss no longer spawns portal before small eyes are dead

CLASSES

Shaman
- Fixed Shamans Earth Totem strength synergy text.
- Fixed Shamans Lava Spill damage.

Viking
- Viking's Zeal now increases damage by 1% per level and is 20% static chance.

Demon Slayer
- Demon Slayer's Light in Darkness now leeches a percentual amount according to your weapon damage per point.
- Demon Slayer's Bullet Hell ability's stat synergy doubled from 5x to 10x
- Demon Slayer's Katana Barrier ability's stat synergy increased from 1x to 10x

Samurai
- Fixed Samurai's Dodge for clients.
- Samurai Improved technically and spells made more dynamic.
- Samurai's Zen Tornado damage scaling doubled.

Pirate
- Fixed Pirates Rapidfire in online multiplayer.
- Increased Pirate parrot's attack speed by 25%

White Mage
- White Mage Restless spirits cooldown lowered.
- White Mage Mana orb cooldown lowered.
- Fixed White Mage Angelic Zone synergy in multiplayer.
- Fixed White Mage in local coop.

Pyromancer
- Pyromancer Meteor chance is now fixed to 20%
- Pyromancer Blaze chance is now fixed to 15%
- Pyromancer's Hydra synergy down to 3x from 4x (energy scaling)
- Fixed Pyromancer spawning less Hydras as a client.

Necromancer
- Necromancer's Meat Bomb synergy increased from 1x to 2x.
- Necromancer's Homing Wisps now move 2x faster.
- Necromancer's Poison nova now has a synergy (Energy)
- Necromancer's Meat Bomb fixed (small meats didn't do the right damage)
- Necromancer's Meat Bomb re-worked, now more constant pattern + explodes on enemy collision
- Necromancer's Meat Bomb cooldown increased a bit.

Marksman
- Marksman's Homing Rocket damage lowered by 10%
- Marksman's Grenade Throw damage lowered by 10%

but a ton more when you hit 150.

- You can no longer use spells while frozen or stunned

- Fixed high item levels displaying incorrectly.
- Fixed item level on dropped items.

notes.title: 1.7.5.0 + Season 2 is here!
notes.content:
We also released a new skin for Pirate, so if you want to support the further development of this game, here is a link where you can get it:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/564730/

Season 2 is now LIVE!


CHRISTMAS PATCH
- A Christmas themed quest chain
- Xmas season update rewards for people who complete the quest chain! 
- Season 2 has started and Season 1 Portrait rewards has been handed to the players!


GENERAL
- The Town of Inoya has been re-built.
- Added a lag removal for the crater objects that explosions leave behind.
- Boosted all attribute scaling on spells +50%
- Increased max life per hit to 16% and mana per hit to 12%
- You can now delete quests by right clicking on the list.
- Quests now have mouse over descriptions.
- Chat tooltips now match the item tooltips 1:1
- Most classes now have their own attack sounds and impact sounds
- Guild description can now be edited.
- Fixed a bug in the loot text when picking up an item.
- Chat linked item tooltips updated, now shows colors right and ilevel
- Re-made bosses Gurag & Anubis
- Addex Toxic Difficulty to the game which scales with your personal highest WH level and 
gives better loot than wormholes.
- Wormhole Keys now cost 250k
- Mystery Chests now cost 3.5k rubies.
- You can now sell all items from current chosen slot pressing 1 button in shop
- Items are now sorted by iLevel (highest shown first)
- Rubies are now reset due to past inhumane drop rates.
- Tab now shows the whole map.
- Mystery hat drops fixed


ITEMS
- Attack speed factor has been halved from what it was.
- Increased all talents + singular talents scaling
- Mystery Boxes no longer drop Satanic and only drop the current WH level mythic gear
- Satanic item spawn rate decreased and these can now only be obtained on wormholes or
toxic difficulty
- Items can now upgrade to Warforged which increases iLevel by 10% or Titanforged which increases iLevel by 25%
- Mystery chest in town now always drops according to destruction, even if difficulty is set to normal
- Mystery chests no longer stack but adds up and increases size of existing chest, removes lag
- You can now see iLevel besides level requirement in inventory (should make browsing easier)
- There is now more range in attack speed for weapons.


WORMHOLES
- Wormhole balance has been changed, you can now see the % on damage and HP buff
- Max wormhole levels awarded now 5 instead of 10.
- Wormhole bosses now drop mystery chests, but loot drop is lower % than in everywhere else.
- Leviathan Orb health decreased from 5 x playercount to 3 x playercount
- Gabriel pillars now explode into a frost nova, freezing and damaging players nearby.
- Hazards now start at level 20 to 100.
- Fixed 150's being able to join wh with a glitch
- 4. rarity enemies no longer have instant reflection, but a 20% chance to get it
- Bosses can no longer be enhanced in order to keep a smooth balance.
- Boss arena's now have a few variations


CLASSES
- Viking Shockwave is now instant and projectile scale increased
- Viking Talent 2 now has a flat % chance and increases critical damage by levels
- Viking Bash now has a flat % chance to happen and increases damage dealt per level

- Pyromancer Armageddon synergy scaling increased by 5 times.
- Pyromancer Fire Nova synergy scaling increased by 4 times.
- Pyromancer Armageddon and Hydra cooldowns reduced.

- Paladin Holy Hammer life increased about 170%
- Paladin Holy Hammer distance speed decreased by 50%
- Paladin Synergy "Holy Shield" has been changed into "Blessed Shields" to remove confusion
between rotating shields and divine shield.
- Fixed a bug in Paladin's Chain Lightning
- Paladin Holy Hammer synergy scaling tripled
- Paladin's Divine Shield cooldown increased and scaling decreased + synergy changed.
- Paladin's Divine Shield Synergy now instead of prolonging the durability, spawns chain lightning 2 times per second when its active.

- Pirate X marks the spot synergy scaling increased from 4 to 6x.
- Pirate Rapid Fire buffed and re-worked, now increases attack speed by 1250 + 10 per talent point.
- Pirate Anchor now lands an aoe smash on point of impact and is scaled 5x with synergy
- Pirate Rapid Fire now lasts 10 seconds.
- While having rapid fire on, pirate's aim gets worse due to recoil.
- Pirate Bomb Barrage no longer grows in range after each pulse
- Pirate X Marks the spot now stuns enemies for 1 second.

- Shaman totems, removed strength scaling from everything else except the earth totem.
- Shaman Storm Totem nerfed, scaling lowered by 50%.
- Shaman's Elemental blast synergy decreased by 50%

- Demonspawn lowered manacalypse damage by 25%
- Demonspawn fixed a bug that boosted damage too much with synergy
- Demonspawn Blood Surge synergy damage decreased from 300% to 200%

- Marksman Multishot now fixed to 5 arrows, only damage scales now.
- Marksman Rocket and Grenade now have 300% increased synergy damage

- Demon Slayer shredder now explodes 4 seconds faster and works correctly upon explosion

- Amazon spearnage synergy scaling buffed from 2.5x to 4x
- Amazon Thunder Spear now has energy synergy
- Amazon Envenom now has strength synergy
- Amazon Thunder Spear now always procs Tropical Thunder

notes.content:
We also released a new skin for Pirate, so if you want to support the further development of this game, here is a link where you can get it:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/564730/

Season 2 is now LIVE!


CHRISTMAS PATCH
- A Christmas themed quest chain
- Xmas season update rewards for people who complete the quest chain! 
- Season 2 has started and Season 1 Portrait rewards has been handed to the players!


GENERAL
- The Town of Inoya has been re-built.
- Added a lag removal for the crater objects that explosions leave behind.
- Boosted all attribute scaling on spells +50%
- Increased max life per hit to 16% and mana per hit to 12%
- You can now delete quests by right clicking on the list.
- Quests now have mouse over descriptions.
- Chat tooltips now match the item tooltips 1:1
- Most classes now have their own attack sounds and impact sounds
- Guild description can now be edited.
- Fixed a bug in the loot text when picking up an item.
- Chat linked item tooltips updated, now shows colors right and ilevel
- Re-made bosses Gurag & Anubis
- Addex Toxic Difficulty to the game which scales with your personal highest WH level and 
gives better loot than wormholes.
- Wormhole Keys now cost 250k
- Mystery Chests now cost 3.5k rubies.
- You can now sell all items from current chosen slot pressing 1 button in shop
- Items are now sorted by iLevel (highest shown first)
- Rubies are now reset due to past inhumane drop rates.
- Tab now shows the whole map.
- Mystery hat drops fixed


ITEMS
- Attack speed factor has been halved from what it was.
- Increased all talents + singular talents scaling
- Mystery Boxes no longer drop Satanic and only drop the current WH level mythic gear
- Satanic item spawn rate decreased and these can now only be obtained on wormholes or
toxic difficulty
- Items can now upgrade to Warforged which increases iLevel by 10% or Titanforged which increases iLevel by 25%
- Mystery chest in town now always drops according to destruction, even if difficulty is set to normal
- Mystery chests no longer stack but adds up and increases size of existing chest, removes lag
- You can now see iLevel besides level requirement in inventory (should make browsing easier)
- There is now more range in attack speed for weapons.


WORMHOLES
- Wormhole balance has been changed, you can now see the % on damage and HP buff
- Max wormhole levels awarded now 5 instead of 10.
- Wormhole bosses now drop mystery chests, but loot drop is lower % than in everywhere else.
- Leviathan Orb health decreased from 5 x playercount to 3 x playercount
- Gabriel pillars now explode into a frost nova, freezing and damaging players nearby.
- Hazards now start at level 20 to 100.
- Fixed 150's being able to join wh with a glitch
- 4. rarity enemies no longer have instant reflection, but a 20% chance to get it
- Bosses can no longer be enhanced in order to keep a smooth balance.
- Boss arena's now have a few variations


CLASSES
- Viking Shockwave is now instant and projectile scale increased
- Viking Talent 2 now has a flat % chance and increases critical damage by levels
- Viking Bash now has a flat % chance to happen and increases damage dealt per level

- Pyromancer Armageddon synergy scaling increased by 5 times.
- Pyromancer Fire Nova synergy scaling increased by 4 times.
- Pyromancer Armageddon and Hydra cooldowns reduced.

- Paladin Holy Hammer life increased about 170%
- Paladin Holy Hammer distance speed decreased by 50%
- Paladin Synergy "Holy Shield" has been changed into "Blessed Shields" to remove confusion
between rotating shields and divine shield.
- Fixed a bug in Paladin's Chain Lightning
- Paladin Holy Hammer synergy scaling tripled
- Paladin's Divine Shield cooldown increased and scaling decreased + synergy changed.
- Paladin's Divine Shield Synergy now instead of prolonging the durability, spawns chain lightning 2 times per second when its active.

- Pirate X marks the spot synergy scaling increased from 4 to 6x.
- Pirate Rapid Fire buffed and re-worked, now increases attack speed by 1250 + 10 per talent point.
- Pirate Anchor now lands an aoe smash on point of impact and is scaled 5x with synergy
- Pirate Rapid Fire now lasts 10 seconds.
- While having rapid fire on, pirate's aim gets worse due to recoil.
- Pirate Bomb Barrage no longer grows in range after each pulse
- Pirate X Marks the spot now stuns enemies for 1 second.

- Shaman totems, removed strength scaling from everything else except the earth totem.
- Shaman Storm Totem nerfed, scaling lowered by 50%.
- Shaman's Elemental blast synergy decreased by 50%

- Demonspawn lowered manacalypse damage by 25%
- Demonspawn fixed a bug that boosted damage too much with synergy
- Demonspawn Blood Surge synergy damage decreased from 300% to 200%

- Marksman Multishot now fixed to 5 arrows, only damage scales now.
- Marksman Rocket and Grenade now have 300% increased synergy damage

- Demon Slayer shredder now explodes 4 seconds faster and works correctly upon explosion

- Amazon spearnage synergy scaling buffed from 2.5x to 4x
- Amazon Thunder Spear now has energy synergy
- Amazon Envenom now has strength synergy
- Amazon Thunder Spear now always procs Tropical Thunder

notes.title: Happy Halloween! Patch 1.7.1.2
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5560948/ff85c668fa4330d35e8164d397c84d6ad5c5526b.png

Halloween Update is now live! 

A new journey awaits every adventurer to demolish the Pumpkin King!

Patch Notes:

HALLOWEEN EVENT
- New original Halloween themed soundtrack by Antti Martikainen
- A Quest Chain to kill the Pumpkin King!
- Spooky assets and halloween mood!
- Seasonal Rewards and achievement that can only be completed during Halloween!

MAJOR
- New quest log system added into the game. You can now have multiple quests on at the same time!
- Added a system that displays debuff timers on top of your player such as "Frozen", "Slowed", "Poisoned", "Burning", "Stunned" Etc.
- Damien and Grim Reaper bosses re-worked!
- Damien's Throne + Act 3 ending changed into "Damien's Nightmare".

WORMHOLES
- Wormhole levels and Hero Levels compressed down to 10% of its original value in order to improve the difficulty curve of Wormholes and improve the item vs difficulty curve
- iLevel compressed to 60% from what it was in order to improve the difficulty curve of Wormholes and improve the item vs difficulty curve
- Fixed a crash with WH Parasectoid Boss.
- Wormholes now add up to 5 hazards 1 per 100 levels.
Hazard 1 (Berserk):
- Enemies belowe 25% HP gain 150% Damage, 150% Increased movement speed, grow slightly in size and turning red.
Hazard 2 (Volcanic Eruption):
- When in Combat small craters spawn on the feet of players that erupt after a second causing massive damage + burning debuff
Hazard 3 (Corrosive Pools): 
- When an enemy Dies, it leaves behind a pool of corrosive blood that heals enemies and damages the player
Hazard 4 (Molten Heart):
- When an enemy Dies, it also leaves behind a ball of lava that explodes and deals AOE damage + causes burning debuff.
Hazard 5 (Reaping):
- Every time you kill an enemy you gain few seconds of bleeding that stacks per enemy death. Every stack ticks for a % of your Max Health. The debuff wont stack in time and fades off after seconds.

GENERAL
- Fixed skins and awkward HUD in local coop.
- Fixed stash losing items in singleplayer.
- Fixed act 4-3 portal not working.
- Burning Damage now applied from burning sources and now deals 5% max hp per second.
- Fixed Clients taking damage 2 times more frequently from spells and enemy abilities
- Fixed health and mana bar being glitchy as F on player and enemies.
- Fixed Life per hit and Mana per hit for clients
- Fixed Anubis Icon bug
- Fixed getting kicked from WH
- Code optimization to make the game run a bit smoother.

CLASSES
- Demonspawn Manacalypse now scales Talent Number X mana and has a 5x Energy Synergy
- Shaman Totem STR scaling lowered from 0.00005% per point to 0.00002% per point
- Paladin Holy Shock aura now scales with Energy
- Pirate parrot damage increased from 100 + (talent X 100) to 1500 + (talent X 1500) damage
and synergy scaling increased from 3x to 5x.
- Pirate Bomb Barrage damage increased from 100 + (talent X 100) to 1000 + (talent X 1000) damage 
and synergy scaling increased from 3x to 5x.
- Pyromancer fireswarm damage increased from 30 + (talent X 30) to 100 + (talent X 100) damage 
and synergy scaling increased from 1x to 5x.

notes.title: Welcome to 1.7.0.5
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5560948/4c9c92dcf4773d5fd7ceedfd66718409231a1dee.png

MAJOR
- Wormhole areas re-made completely with new themes
- Wormhole packs are no longer randomized but pre-placed
- Wormhole bosses now have their own throne which appears after clearing the enemies.
- iLevel cap in wormholes removed completely.
- All talents and singular talents now scale for a possibility of 1 per 100 ilevel.
- Ranking system reset and re-done, groups now have their own ladders (2,3,4) + solo
^ Every unique group has its own rank.
- Guilds now have reputation that grants perks.
- Added Stash into the town where you can store items.
- Siege Mode is back and can be accessed from a town NPC.
- HLevel compressed to the current XP Scaling, since every Hlevel max experience raised
and wormhole scales EXP the further you go.
- Added 3 new bosses to the wormhole.

GENERAL
- Fixed Demonspawn talent names being scrambled.
- Fixed Nomad's Demolishing Tornado damage.
- Fixed Necromancer crash on clients.
- iLevel scaling lowered a bit.
- Enemy damage now scales by +25% per player in group
- Enemy HP now scales by 100% per player in group instead of 75%
- Removed iLevel cap from items Made curve harder.
- Fixed client vs host xp ratio.
- Autoequipping item now updates stats.
- Minimap is now on by default and can be turned off by pressing "M" or Middle Mouse Button
- Promoting a player to admin in a guild now updates the status.
- Fixed hat not shown on Demonspawn.
- All sliders can now be dragged.
- Your portrait now updates as you get more hero levels.
- The pack system in wormholes got a massive re-vamp.
- Fixed minimap for every dungeon, crypt and zone in game.
- Hero Level max experience now multiplies with the actual hero level.
- Life per hit and Mana per hit are now fixed % of players max mana or max hp
- Trading items has been removed.
- Swapped ACT 3 and ACT 4 in order to make the lore better.
- Opened ACT 5, 6, 7 by default in order to not be tied to each other.
- Life per hit and Mana per hit has been re-calculated into your existing weapons with the new system
- Combat text and names etc are now transparent in order to give more visibility.
- Other player's projectiles and effects are now transparent.
- If a HC character dies or you delete a character, its guild spot will remove too.
- Melees now take 10% decreased damage from enemy melee attacks.
- Enemy Barrage arrows reduced from 8 to 6
- Fixed skeleton warrior spin going through walls

WORMHOLES
- Higher Wormholes now give more experience.
- Randomized wormholes removed for good, made pre-made ones with themes.
- Every 10% of the wormhole timer is now 1 level, so if you do it so that you have 90% left you
gain 9 wormhole levels from the upgrade instead of the old 1. 1 is the minimum if you beat it 
before the timer runs out.
- If a player under 150 is in a wormhole, the whole group will be kicked to the town.
- Every 20 WH multiplies the enemy HP scaling and armor scaling.
- WH Packs changed a bit, not that many elites now.

CLASSES
- Nomad Wind & Sand proc chance lowered from 20% to 6%
& expires 1 second faster + damage synergy lowered 33%
- Samurai Focus now procs at 6 attacks instead of 10 and 6 is halved with chest/helm synergy
- Samurai Focus attribute scale buffed 2x
- Samurai Lightning Enchant attribute scaling buffed from 3x to 5x
- Samurai Vorpal Charge attribute scaling buffed from 1x to 5x
- Samurai Waijin Stone attribute scaling buffed from 3x to 5x
- Samurai Added Energy synergy to Katanoshi
- Shaman Fire totem damage scale with attributes lowered by 65%
- Samurai Ying Yang now heals the samurai for 0.1% per talent point of his max hp when 48 px or closer to an enemy
- Redneck can now attack during chainsaw massacre.
- Demon Slayer bullets now deal 75% of his damage.
- Demon Slayer melee nerfed from 3x dmg to 1.75x
- Pirate Rapidfire has a 50% chance to shoot cannonballs
- Pirate Parrot attack speed increased from 0.5sec to 0.35sec
- Pirate Increased anchor cooldown from 1.5sec to 3sec
- Pirate Doubled anchor strength synergy
- Buffed Redneck Moonshine Madness attack speed from 20 + talent * 2 to 100 + talent * 3
- Pickup Raid bullet speed increased from 8 to 12
- Minions take 25% of reflection damage down from 70%
- Removed AOE ring from # attack
- Necromancer's minions spawn ~17% less cursed hands
- Increased Necromancer's minions speed from 1.5 to 2
- Redneck Moonshine Madness tick chance reduced to flat 30%
- Necromancer's minions stick a bit closer to the player
- Nomad's Wind Master synergy spawns 50% less tornadoes
- Amazon's Poison now scales with 1% per point from Weapon Damage.
- Amazon's Poison now spreads to closest enemies in a range of 32 pixels.

ps. Siege Mode is now in game and can be obtained from NPC Ishmail in Inoya. We will be re-working siege mode in the future!

Hello everyone,

notes.title: Thinking of adding synergies to satanic chests and helms
notes.content:
So I am thinking of adding special synergies to Satanic chests and Helms. There is 3 different synergies for each class at the moment that I've come up with:

Viking
- Gates of Valhalla => A hit that would kill you makes you immortal for 5 seconds instead ( 3 min cooldown )
- Empower => Bash is hit in all 4 directions
- Flames of Odin => when berserk proccs, shoots hellfire in all 4 directions with weapon damage.

Pyro
- Hydrality => Spawns 2 hydras instead of 1 and the hydra projectiles leave a blazing trail.
- The Armageddon => Armageddon does 5x damage with a bigger area of effect
- Meteor Master => Meteors deal 3x damage and are bigger.

Marksman
- Turret Master => max turrets 8 + turrets shoot homing rockets with a 10% chance.
- Colossal Arrow => Shoot 1 huge arrow instead of multishot dealing multishot amount of damage.
- Landing Power => Landing on disengage shoots 15 arrows around with piercing damage.

Pirate
- Mad Bomber => Shoot a cannon ball in all 4 directions with an increased 3x damage.
- Land Ahoy => When Anchor hits an enemy it unleashes 15 piercing bullets around with the anchors damage.
- Rocket Madness => When rapid fire is active pirate shoots homing rockets with her base damage.

Nomad
- Ra's Demise => Eye of Ra hits all enemies on screen
- Sands of Time => Throws 3 sand projectiles instead of 1
- Wind Master => Nomad's 9th talent has a chance to release double the tornados with 3x damage.

Redneck
- Wheels of Doom => 3x Damage on Tire Fire
- Double Raid => 2 trucks in Pickup Raid
- Giant Spin => 3x Damage on Chainsaw Massacre + 2x the area of effect

Necromancer
- Necronomicon => Double the amount of summoned minions you can have.
- Master of Venom => 3x damage in poison nova.
- Meat Wagon => Triples the amount of bits from your corpse bomb.

Samurai
- Vorpal Mind => Vorpal Strike proc from 5 hits instead of 10
- Ice Dragon => 4 times the freezing time.
- Lightning Reflexes => Every time you evade an attack the enemy is struck with chainlightning.

Paladin
- Divine Light => Divine Shield has 3x the duration
- Lightning God => Increases Lightning Fury procc chance to 65%
- Holy Shield => Increases damage of shields x 3 and makes them reflect enemy projectiles.

Amazon
- Ambusher => On jumps landing launches 15 piercing spears around her.
- Thunderstorm => Instead of releasing a thunder proc, releases a small thunderstorm in the location.
- Venom => all poison damage is tripled.

Demon Slayer
- Undead Impact => When you dash and hit an enemy you launch 15 piercing bullets around.
- Demon Slave => Gains an immortal minion that has Demon Slayer's Damage.
- Sixth Sense => Homing Projectiles.

Demonspawn
- Blood Surgery => Blood Surge is now wider, ticks more frequently and deals 3x its damage.
- Manacalyption => Manacalypse cooldown is lowered and multiplier is doubled.
- Impalator => Increases Impale's area of effect and deals 3x its damage.

What are your thoughts and also if you have any synergies in mind for a class please let me know and it might end up in the game!

notes.title: How we will tackle issues with Multiplayer
notes.content:
Hello and thank you all for the feedback!

There are a few really big problems with the game I admit that, but the bigger problem is that fixing those issues is not easy.

Issue #1 - slow down with 4 players and max relics
- This in no way is an easy thing to "fix". We cannot just remove the effects etc from other players because the effects need to exist in order to do damage and work properly (hiding the visuals wont affect slowdown due to the looping code being the reason). 

We will unfortunately have to limit the max amount of relics at once, but we will be bumping up the damage from singular relics alot. We will also remove the non needed particle effects on some of the effects in order to atleast amp down the slowdowns a bit.

Issue #2 - Dedicated servers not working
- It seems that some people have a slightly bigger ping which causes the server to boot them out automatically, since it doesnt give you a message that would explain why you were kicked, people think its a bug. We will be adding the popup message "Disconnected: Ping too High" and we have raised the ping amount up to a higher number for the initial input lag.

Issue #3 - Wormholes
- We will be adding a confirmation to the resetting of wormholes and we will set the opening player's wormhole level as the "master level". If your personal WH level is lower or same as the master level, you will be able to raise your own wormhole level on the end. You will no longer be able to boost your level to forexample 500 by doing level 1 wormholes

Issue #4 - Balance
- Being 4 classes that can only do high WH, I will be boosting the other classes alot. There will also be higher synergy scaling per point so we can get abilities to do massive damage.

Issue #5 - Trading 
- Dupping will be dealt with and weapon life per hit and mana per hit will be fixed too.

These being the top 5 most needed fixes for the game for now. Give me your thoughts, and please stay on topic.

notes.title: What are the biggest problems with MULTIPLAYER?
notes.content:
So since I have been playing the game on and off I haven't really had any technical problems with the multiplayer module, this is why I need you guys to tell me what the biggest problems with it is. I want to know why people say its broken even tho I do not feel its broken at all, so please speak up now.

Also I want to be completely clear to the people who yell that we shouldn't focuse on new content before bugs are fixed: 

Dear customer, we are a team of 2. It consists of me (Elias) and jummijammi (Jussi). 

Jussi is the main programmer, he fixes the bugs, he programs the engine and all the multiplayer related things. Jussi is the guy who is responsible for everything that comes to the gameplay and bugs etc. Jussi is working long days, every day only fixing bugs and ironing out engine problems etc. 

Elias is the game designer/artist/levelbuilder/content creator. His job is to come up with balance, new art assets, level improvement, bulding new content and all this.

Do you now see why we have so much new content? Because Elias cannot fix bugs, Elias does not have the proper skillset to do anything about problems related to multiplayer because he is not a high skilled programmer, but an artist / designer.

Do you understand how teams work? One people works on one thing and the other works on another thing. Hopefully this makes you understand that we cannot put an unskilled artist to fix multiplayer bugs, thank you!

I will gather all the specifics said here, and I will put them in Jussi's tasklist and he will go thru them one by one.

NOTE!!!!!!!
- Crashes regarding "Vertex Buffer" is caused by your bad GPU. this is a "BUG" which is not a BUG and will not be fixed, because it cannot be fixed. Play on a better computer

notes.content:
So since I have been playing the game on and off I haven't really had any technical problems with the multiplayer module, this is why I need you guys to tell me what the biggest problems with it is. I want to know why people say its broken even tho I do not feel its broken at all, so please speak up now.

Also I want to be completely clear to the people who yell that we shouldn't focuse on new content before bugs are fixed: 

Dear customer, we are a team of 2. It consists of me (Elias) and jummijammi (Jussi). 

Jussi is the main programmer, he fixes the bugs, he programs the engine and all the multiplayer related things. Jussi is the guy who is responsible for everything that comes to the gameplay and bugs etc. Jussi is working long days, every day only fixing bugs and ironing out engine problems etc. 

Elias is the game designer/artist/levelbuilder/content creator. His job is to come up with balance, new art assets, level improvement, bulding new content and all this.

Do you now see why we have so much new content? Because Elias cannot fix bugs, Elias does not have the proper skillset to do anything about problems related to multiplayer because he is not a high skilled programmer, but an artist / designer.

Do you understand how teams work? One people works on one thing and the other works on another thing. Hopefully this makes you understand that we cannot put an unskilled artist to fix multiplayer bugs, thank you!

I will gather all the specifics said here, and I will put them in Jussi's tasklist and he will go thru them one by one.

notes.title: PVP Mode
notes.content:
Its now time to discuss this.

We will be adding PVP to the game at some point, so here are some of my thoughts how it will play out:

- there will be no inventory items in arenas
- there will be no relics in arenas
- hero levels wont work in arenas
- temp stats wont work in arenas

Basically arenas are only for naked 150 level chars.

There will be a special Queue button to que in a pvp game. It will put 2 random players with the same rating into an arena where they fight till death and the winner gains rating while the looser loses rating.

There will be leaderboards and very strickt cheat scanning.

notes.title: About Mana
notes.content:
Hellllloo!

So yeah totally my bad on the patch that lower level heroes got overlooked and manacosts bumped up hard. 

The current mana system is exponential. This means the first 10 levels on a talent don't bump it up too much, my level 1 pyro could spam his 1st spell for about forever since it costs only 20 mana and base mana is 500.

Having MAX talent points means you need MAX gear, isnt this just obvious?

The point now being that:

1) you need to gear up and focus on energy if you want to go active talent ways
2) you need to think about your inventory and your build, not just mindlessly having everything. Its pointless to have mana if it never becomes an issue or makes you need to think about what kind of items you pick up.
3) Wormholes having higher manacost requirements reason is that we want the players to be GEARED up before going there, meaning uber damien sheep king etc, destruction act 7 mythic gear. 

There will be another patch later today which will bump Mana per Energy rate from 5 to 8 and has sligthly decreased the scaling of mana per level.

- Peace out.

notes.title: Huge revamp in wormholes incoming
notes.content:
Hello,

So today me and our game tester / designer sat down to eat sushi and discuss Hero Siege's Endgame. We decided to bring some unique monster types for wormholes as well as bumping up the item scaling and lowering the maximum wormholes in leaderboards in order to make it more challenging and less grindy.

_There will be a wormhole level reset_

We will be adding atleast these enemy-types:
- Reflection (Every once in a while puts up a shield that reflects 100% damage back to the player)
- Lavastorm (Unleashes a river of lava towards the player, dealing trap damage)
- Thunderstorm (Spawns a glowing spot on the player unleashing a powerful lightning that divides into 8 directions dealing massive damage).

We also made the scaling of enemies vs wormhole level exponential rather than the progressive we had, so every wormhole will be VERY different and harder than the one before.

You can now choose to either grind the current level, or press a button next to the portal in order to grow it after the boss kill.

Cheers and patch as soon as we get it working!

notes.title: Next Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am keeping you guys in the loops about what we are doing and what will be in the next patch. So here you go:

- We introduce Satanic weapons which is a tier higher than Mythic. These weapons have bigger max attack speed than mythics, more primary and off stats as well as more damage and unique attack modifiers that you wont get from other rarity weapons.

- There will be a ton of new sprites for the legendary up weapons.

- All damage taken will be moved client side, so nothing you cant see cant kill you anymore. This means even if the game is a bit desynced, what happens on your screen matters.

- Attack Speed has been nerfed, scaling slower than before and relics nerfed. This is to prevent too much bullet hell and concentrating the damage dealing from damage instead. 

- Armor is now diminishing so it can go up to 99%. This means the first 200 points count more than the rest 1000 etc. 

- Buffed Wormhole Key drop rate from 25% to 50%.

- Buffed Wormhole Mythic drop chances.

- Fixed Experience gains and Set wormhole experience factors.

- Wormholes cannot be entered if there is a lower than level 150 player in the group.

Also lots of fixes for nasty glitches and bugs.

If you have requests state them below, thanks!

- PAS Team

notes.title: January update
notes.content:
Hello lads!

We are now back from our 1 month Vacation, refreshed non stressed and ready to go for 2016!

We had our first meeting yesterday where we did a roadmap for 2016. I want to be transparent about the Hero Siege Part in January, so here it goes:

- We are focusing only on Hero Siege in January and will set Eastfound aside for now. 
- We are gonna tackle as many multiplayer sided issues as possible and fix them asap.
- Our programmer Uabel is working on ironing out the flaws in dedicated servers, we are re-config our linux server from our provider in order to put the dedicated server online again (our provider for some reason stopped our contract during christmas so sorry for that, we have renewed it now).
- We will add US servers and look for a South Korean provider for Asian servers
- Me and Terralus will be focusing on polishing Hero Siege: Pocket Edition for iOS and Android and setting a release date for it

If you have any questions, please ask and we will try our best to answer it if its relevant. and yes we are a core team of 2 developers, our third guy just works on servers n such.

notes.title: Tomorrow's patch and feedback
notes.content:
Hello!

So we will be working hard for the next couple of days ironing out small bugs n stuff due to the massive update, we did have alot of inhouse testing done by our awesome tester "Sarcaster" who is a new member of our crew!

What will be in tomorrow's patch:
- Option to turn on health text on top of the healthbars on enemies
- Making the healthbars a bit bigger
- Ironing out small bugs and glitches reported by you guys today.

We are sorry for wiping your items, it is something we did NOT want to do, but what we HAD to do. We dont do these things to piss you off or ruin your life, we love you!

Please leave us constructive feedback, we want to make the game better. But down right flaming is something that will not only damage the game, the community but also destroy our motivation to work on improving the game.

We are a really small team, and we are not industry veterans nor we work like professional companies so we don't know how to do PR right or handle situations right. We are basement developers.

Be nice to us and we will be nice to you and everyone wins :) Thanks for everyone who supports us, we will be here for you!

notes.title: 1.4.2.3 is OUT!
notes.content:
NOTE!
- ALL ITEMS ARE WIPED IN THIS PATCH!
- DEDICATED SERVERS ARE STILL IN TEST, IF THE SERVER IS OFFLINE USE THE LOCAL OPTION TO HOST!

GENERAL
- Reworked enemy healthbars.
- Optimized and improved some enemies, added new skills to them.
- Longered ranged enemy distance from player.
- "You Died" positioning fixed.
- ES relic fixed.
- Paladins talents not activating fixed.
- Darkness setting not saving fixed.
- Ingame volume slider fixed.
- Chat Lobby re-made.
- Mana system added, cooldowns re-worked.
- Attack Speed is now tied to weapon items.
- Added Satanic Mode event that increases zone enemies damage, hp and boss rarity to 4.
- Fireswarm damage fixed.
- Holy Shock Aura damage fixed.
- You can now whisper in the chat lobby by using /w "playername" "message".
- Game complete achievement is now always earned from ACT 4 which is the ending of Hero Siege classic.
- Name Prefixes are also earned from beating ACT 4.
- Relics are now saved in multiplayer.
- All difficulties are open for anyone, you no longer need to unlock them.
- Players now have a light on them in dark places, lanterns have been removed.
- Viking 9th talent has been re-worked.
- Talent attribute scaling is now according to talent level, so you cannot achieve huge damage boosts for a +1 talent.
- "Damage Over Time" Spells no longer lose impact if there are many doing damage at the same time.
- Several classes balanced, Nomad buffed etc.
- Siege mode is now available for all players.
- Level cap is now 150, after that you will earn "hero levels", which apply to ALL your +150 level characters.
- Gold is now account based and does not reset upon death or game completion anymore.
- Hardcore in multiplayer fixed.


INVENTORY
- Inventory system re-made. You now have a inventory you can fill by picking up
items from the ground. You can trade them with other players etc. Items can now 
be sold to merchants in the town of Inoya.
- The green and red triangles indicate wether the item is worse or better than the one
you have equipped in certain area (Offensive, Defensive, Utility).
- Item stats are now balanced better

notes.title: Status Update 21.08.2015
notes.content:
Helloooooo!!!

So giving a new status update on what we have done and what we will do next.

So what we did, we hired an inhouse game tester who is a student and works 2 nights a week at our office. He will be needed alot and he is already paying off!

So what have we been up to? So much silence: 
- We made dedicated servers which are working, we will be settling US / EU / Asia server providers next.
- The Wormhole system is working and looking awesome!
- Act 7 is half way there.
- Mana system is implemented and working (Game tester will manage balancing and testing).
- Weapons now have base damage, attackspeed and life per hit stats
- Inventory items now have level requirement.
- Full inventory system has been implemented and its working! You can now drop, trade, equip and gather loot in your backbag.
- We added a small chance that a zone becomes "Satanic" and makes the zone more dangerous!
- Re-vamped chat menu with server list etc.

What next?
- Finish off zones for ACT 7
- Program ACT 7 main boss
- Design new classes 
- Clan system

We will most likely take max 2 months to finish everything. We'll see :)

notes.title: A little status update about "Wrath of Mevius".
notes.content:
Hellllloo!

So we have been working on the next expansion in silence pretty much. I want to update here what we have done and what we are working on next.

Our extra artist Aapeli has the skills to program in c++, so we put him to do a c++ dedicated server which communicates with Game Maker. This was something Jussi and him was working for the past 2 weeks and it was successful. We are putting this feature up for test in the upcoming closed beta. So no longer need to portforward once its updated into the stable!

I've been working on new art and the zones for Act 7. I have 3 zones done and enemies for the first one. There is still alot to do.

I am currently working on designing rest of the zones and later the new classes.

Jussi is working on the full inventory system, dropping and trading loot etc.

Aapeli is now working on concepting new enemies.

We have settled in our new office and are working hard. After the Expansion we will maintain bugfix patching for the game and overal support, but will move on to a new game for a change. We will be doing more for Hero Siege in the future, but for now we need a break to keep stuff fresh.

notes.title: Multiplayer Plans & Server stuff [Important]
notes.content:
Hello to all of you awesome people who play our game!

So we have experienced some very unexpected burst of new players, which is ofcourse very welcome! We are really glad there are new players who enjoy the game!

We are doing everything in our power to make the game the best possible experience for all of you. So here are some future plans we are going to be doing:

- Steam MATCHMAKING Api integration (no more PORTFORWARDING!)
- Ingame Friends List where you can message your friends, check them online, invite them to play etc. (this will be crossplatform between consoles, mobile and PC).
- Clan system, you will be able to create and join clans (1 clan per character). Clans also will have their own chat channels.

These are mostly the ingame features we will be adding in the near future!

And as there have been some problems with the server hardware, we are going to be throwing a ton of $$$ into the server hardware upgrades.

We will be putting 2 XEON processors (the best and top of the line ones) into the server computer to keep it running in the heat!

PS. We will be off on holiday @ Japan from tomorrow till the 1st of July and back to work then.

notes.title: DLC Development update
notes.content:
Hello to everyone!

I wanted to drop by and let you guys know how we are doing at the moment and what we are doing. We are working hard on the DLC content and Jussi is putting his finishing touches into the multiplayer. As you can see, its getting more stable with every of the latest patches and the chat lobby is already looking good.

We are pretty happy that there are always active players online playing the game, and hope the numbers will grow once we get the DLC and multiplayer out for the public! Siege Mode will most likely drive alot of attention, but more about that later.

Also we started updating our dev blog which can be found here, more pictures and work flow there: http://panicartstudios.blogspot.fi/

We are also pushing for a June / July XBOX One release so its a pretty hectic time, PS4 will follow the XBOX release shortly after.

notes.title: Huge Multiplayer patch out!
notes.content:
Hello guys!!

We have been working hard on the multiplayer for the past few weeks and also fixed all the bugs reported in the bug topic, here are the notes! Kudos!

patch notes 1.2.4.8 (newest)

CLASSES
- Odin's Fury Fixed
- Shockwave and Seismic Slam graphics enhanced
- Marksman turret projectiles now destroy when hit a wall
- Pyro Hydra projectiles also now destroy when hit a wall
- Pyro's spells now have impact sounds

GENERAL
- You can no longer fly thru into the treasure fort.
- If you save & exit after killing a boss, you now instantly go into the next zone
after you continue.
- Projectiles which destroy them self on impact now dont activate the "invicibility frame"
nor cares if its on, these projectiles will always deal damage to enemies and to players
- Treasure fort relic now warps under the player so it can be switched.
- Hats dissapearing in Dungeons fixed.
- Removed "King's Path" and replaced it with "King's Garden".
- Removed "The Garden" and replaced it with "Pumpkin Patch".

RELICS
- Ankh crashing on Player 2 fixed.

ENEMIES
- Skeleton Mages now cast various spells.

CO-OP
- RELIC - Rainbow Drool now works for both players.
- RELIC -  Duck now works for both players.
- RELIC -  Scythe now works for both players.


MULTIPLAYER
- Enemies now react to Obelisks
- Player now always starts with full HP and keeps his HP.
- Hayro boss fireballs now sync with clients.
- Fixed various bugs and crashes that were reported.
- Fixed Pyromancer Blazing Trail bugging
- Pyro's spells coming from the host also fixed
- Players and Dead flags are now removed from games when player crashes or leaves, no more "ACT 1 Vikings"
- Skeleton Archer projectiles now sync with clients
- Fixed game telling that no internet connection and going to windowed mode
- Bekanthamun Tornado crashing game fixed
- Added (x / 4) player indicator into the server list.
- Picking up a potion or a relic now stops the player ghost.
- Added a REMEMBER ME button that saves your login name.
For security reasons the game won't save your password.
- Added mind bubbles that indicate wether a player is browsing his/her talents or writing
in the chat.
- Improved the drawing of name and future clan tags
- THE EYE Boss projectiles now synced with clients.
- Optimized player position package sending to 60 ticks per second.
- Dungeon Enemies now synced with clients
- Passive enemies no longer move when juggernaut  active.
- Hex effects now shows on all players
- Players no longer spawn with reduced health

notes.title: PATCH 1.2.3.1 is out
notes.content:
patch notes 1.2.3.1 (newest)

MULTIPLAYER						
- Boss lair crash fixed						
- Trap_dir, startup and multiple other crashes fixed						
- Fixed a few Marksman talents						
						
GENERAL						
- Re-written the whole achievement system to be more dynamic						
- Vibration option for gamepad added						
- Players no longer take damage during pause (if you stand in a pool of slime etc).						
- Traps and enemy damage scaled according to act and difficulty with a new algorithm, no more cheapshots.						
- There is now an indication of the boss throne dungeon appearing.						
						
MINION						
- Minions now have health and aggro + they can be revived like players.						
						
ENEMIES						
- Added a new enchant type "Juggernaut"						
- Enemy Health bars now indicate lost HP (Green / Yellow / Red).						
						
CLASSES						
- Marksman multishot has been nerfed, you now need 30 points in order to shoot 4						
projectiles. each point adds 10% chance to shoot additional projectiles. every 10 levels						
add an additional projectile. 10 = 2 arrows, 20 = 3 arrows, 30 = 4 arrows.						
15 = 50% chance to shoot 3 arrows, if not then shoots 2 arrows and so on.						
- Marksman landmines re-worked.						
- Necromancer first talent replaced by Cursed Hands talent.						
- Necromancer projectiles and effects re-made completely						
- Pyromancer projectile effect re-made						
						
CO-OP (2 player local)						
- There is now charm drops for each player individually.						
- Bugs have been fixed

notes.title: BIG update (sorry mac users)
notes.content:
A HUGE update is out. Also i will export MAC when my laptop stops acting up, i cannot get my mac to connect my PC in order to export the game.

Here are the patch notes:

patch notes 1.2.2.9 (newest)

MAJOR MODIFICATION		
				
- Act end bosses now have their own "Throne Rooms". Instead of a boss spawning from the pentagram						
it now spawns a dungeon which takes you underground to the boss lair.						
- Minibosses now have their own voice acting						

GENERAL
				
- Added Glimmer effect to the coins						
- Resetting stats no longer removes charms						
- Ranged minion skins fixed						
- The minion tab in the shop is now navigable with the dpad						
- Armor effectiveness doubled						
- Added randomly spawning Health Shrines into the game which replenishes health for all players (full hp)						
- Doubled coin pickup range						
- Slightly lowered the chance of enemies dropping crystal keys						
- Reduced enemy attack damage scaling						
- Added skills for minions						
- Collectors Edition purchasers now get 2500 rubies in multiplayer						
- Re-made the Crypt Graphics.						
- Going into shop minion tab instantly chooses the melee minion, fixed.						
- Minion damage and health now shows up correctly in the statistics tab ingame.						
- The game now checks for gamepad input every once in a while so you can unplug and re-plug						
- Beating the game on normal doesn't open nightmare without DLC fixed						
- Passive Enemies bugging and glitching in front of the Skeleton Cave fixed						
- Act 3 flower beds can now be destroyed						
- Shop room enlargened, now works in co-op properly.						
						
RELICS / ITEMS	
					
- Re-worked razer headset effect						
- Charms must be picked up now, pressing Enter or GamePad button						
- Titan's Gladius Relic has been fixed, it now only affects normal enemies.						
- Health Globes now heal 10% of player's max hp						
- Relics now show up correctly in the pause screen when the game is loaded						
- Hex and Stun effects are now lesser vs bosses						
- Crystal Keys are now per character						
- Increased gold drop rate for Chests, Vases, Boxes						
- Blazing Boots damage increased						
						
CO-OP			
			
- Player 2 in co-op can now also buy stuff in Treasure Fort.						
- in co-op both players have their own lanterns now (DUNGEON)						
- Both players will receive familiars and orbits now in co-op						
						
CLASSES	
					
- Pyromancer Armageddon Buffed and fixed						
- Viking Shockwave buffed						
- Necromancers Soul Channel damage increased and graphics re-made						
- Added new sound effects for necro's projectiles and Pyromancer's Fire Swarm						
- Pyromancer's Fireswarm has been re-worked						
- Samurais vorpal enchant no longer gets you inside the wall in treasure fort						
- Increased Necro's minion base max HP						
- Minions now have a 30% damage reduction from all sources.						
- Rednecks talent 8 has been remade						
						
MINIBOSSES	
					
- King Khorga now has the Ability "Meathook".						
- Betankhamun now has the Ability "Sand Tornado".						
- Hayro has been fixed						
- Dahzul now has the Ability "Spiky Ball".						
- Kayo the Sapling now has the Ability "Spider Web".						
- Parasectoid now has the Ability "Red Ball of Doom".						
- Pontus now has the Ability "Acid Spray".						
						
MULTIPLAYER
						
- Several reported multiplayer crashes fixed.

notes.title: Database wipe before MP release
notes.content:
Hello,

Before we will release multiplayer to the public, we will be wiping the databases clean. This is because the MP and our login system are in beta-testing phase at the moment and there have been several fails during the time.

Don't take it personal, take it as a clean start for everyone. We will add multiplayer achievements, ranking etc. these things require us to wipe the saves.

There is also a problem with the login system which currently is case sensitive, and needs to be re-rolled to non-case sensitive because there are multiple similar login names existing at the moment. Because of this, we will be also deleting all accounts that were created to Panic.net

I hope you guys understand. 

There is still no ETA, but we are moving close so i thought this would be a good time to let you know so you won't be surprized by this.

- paNicci

notes.title: New Shop System Balance patch is out!
notes.content:
There is a lot of hurt going on regarding the new system.

We are working on balancing it, improving it as we go. We have now done these things to enhance it:

- Increased money drop by 10%				
- Increased Treasure Fort spawn chance from 8% to 25%				
- Increased stacked bushes gold drop chance greatly				
- Improved the floating text from gold pickups				
- Lowered Treasure Fort Attribut costs from 100 per attribute to 40 per attribute				
- Money Rain event now drops also silver and gold coins with a small chance				
- Increased Money drop from Golden Chests Greatly				
- Elite monsters now have a 10% chance to drop a key		

We are prolly going to add health shrines to kinda eaze the loss of health potions into the game.

anyway give us your feedback with how it feels etc so we can keep on improving.

- Peace out

notes.title: Currency System Re-Worked and Co-op bug fixed
notes.content:
Hello fellow citizen of Tarethiel!

I have good news for you!!

We have been busting our nerves and working long days to make this patch. We have made big moderations such as complete re-work of the currency system.

Currency System:
- Gold now drops in coin amounts +1,+5,+10 (bronze, silver, gold).
- Gold can no longer be used in the ingame shop since it is removed.
- Gold is now used in the randomly spawning "Treasure Fort" Which takes you to a underground secret shop where you can spend it. There is now temp stats randomed amount scaling the price by 40 per point. There is a random magic potion that you can buy, and a random relic.
- The reason for this, is to make the game more roguelikeish and take the repetetive boring shop off which was there before.

Co-op BUG FIXED:
- There was this nasty bug that turned the other player into a level 1 viking wiping the existing save info. This has been fixed finally thanks to a community member! Thanks!

full patch log:

patch notes 1.2.2.6 (newest)
- Animation re-vamped for Relics
- Decreased damage received from cannon and fire traps
- Orbit Relic damage over time increased
- Decreased damage received from fire enchanted enemies
- Re-worked the whole money system. There no longer is huge amounts of money dropping. There is no longer an ingame shop you can open and close which is now replaced with a "Treasure Fort" that randomly appears like dungeons
- Collectables now follow you smoothly and no longer twitch and jump around
- Rapid Fire for Pirate in Online leave's the attack speed after fading off Fixed
- Pirate Anchor Hook now fixed (there was multiple bugs before).
- Transfering Offline chars to online fixed
- Fixed other player getting other's stats in co-op
- Minion MAX EXP increased
- Minion DAMAGE nerfed
- Minions now save in Online Multiplayer
- Online multiplayer now only drops rubies instead of crystals. Online and offline have	 separate currency and shop from now on.
- Level 1 viking co-op bug FIXED FINALLY!
- Fixed ranged minion having the wrong skin
- Fixed Viking Seismic Slam tooltip
- Fire Nova and Fire Swarm now 100% proc Blazing Trail if skilled
- Nerfed the Damage of Anubis and Karp King with about -50%

notes.title: Minion Patch is out
notes.content:
This one was a bit bigger, lots of important fixes and optimization.

The minions have been set up, but there is still lots to do with it. So we will be updating the minion more next week.

here are the patch notes:

patch notes 1.2.2.5 (newest)
- Re-made the whole scaling system. The game now has a progressive XP gaining system and progressive health / dmg increases for enemies according to rarity, wave and difficulty.

- Multiplayer Lobby now has the option to choose ACT and Difficulty by the host. Also after all the players die it will take everyone back to the same lobby for a re-match.

- Lots of shadows have been re-worked to look better.

- Some enemy names have been altered
- Elite enemies now have a 15% chance of dropping Charms.

- Fixed "You have unlocked [difficulty]" bug.
- Fixed Credits music playing in menu bug.

- Attackspeed optimized to all players in Multiplayer. Players will no longer get other player's buffs like marksman agility or pirate rapid fire

- Asset bug fixes in Multiplayer
- Packet Rate optimization in Multiplayer, smoothens the gameplay.

- Fixed Charm menu instantly opening on Gamepad when starting a game.

- Added 4 new hats!

- Added melee and ranged minions (next patches will bring more content into this)
- Melee and Ranged each have 4 alternative skins to unlock and 1 collectors skin each.

notes.title: DLC Patch is out!
notes.content:
Greetings to all you Heroes out there!

We have just patched the Karp of Doom patch which will also bring some new stuff to the people who are not planning on buying the DLC.

The patch notes can be viewed here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/269210/discussions/0/540732596436401526/

The DLC is coming out tonight, in a few hours hopefully (We had a little mixup with steam so I hope I can get in contact with them to successfully launch the DLC...)

also note that the multiplayer is still lacking stuff even tho its playable. Also read the stuff about opening ports on your router, you wont be able to host without doing that as the game uses porftorwarding since we dont have dedicated servers... atleast yet.

If there are bugs or crashes please report them to the new BUG REPORT topic and remember to copy paste the error code there and explain the situation as well as you can in order to make it as easy as possible for us! :)

We will be doing our fair share of testing the multiplayer so please dont treat the EA as making the players test the game, but letting the players TASTE it before its final release.

You are in no obligation to report bugs to us if you dont want to, we dont by any means want to make you work for us for free.

That would be all, HAVE FUN! Thanks for being awesome everyone!

notes.title: Hero Siege save system announcement
notes.content:
Alright so this is what we are going to do.

We will remove the autosyncing steam cloud as it is causing loads of problems... We will return the local saving and loading as it was before. We will always make the player save locally and to the cloud when he exits the game, but the load will always be from the local files. 

We will add a button in the options menu which says "Sync with Steam Cloud". If you press this button, the game will then remove all the local save files and download the save files from the cloud and save them into the local directory.

This way no saves will ever be lost, and you can just retrieve your save state from the cloud manually to your laptop etc.

And again really sorry, hope we get the characters generated and we can concentrate on working more content for the game. Peace out.

- Tupu
